title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics, tracing, dashboard and alert tuning
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: We observed regressed unit economics on the serving fleet for several customers where token-level KV cache miss rates spiked during bursty workloads, increasing per-token GPU work and tail latencies. This PR adds explicit token-level KV cache metrics, tracing spans around KV lookup and population, a Grafana dashboard for KV/token metrics, and tuned alerting to reduce noisy pagers while keeping SRE eyes on degradations. What I changed (high level): - Metrics: added token_kv_cache_hits_total, token_kv_cache_misses_total, token_kv_cache_hit_ratio (derived), token_kv_cache_miss_cost_tokens_total (approx cost of misses in tokens), token_processing_latency_seconds histogram (token-level latency buckets), and labels (model, shard, region, route). - Tracing: instrumented kv.lookup and kv.populate with spans and added span attributes for key_id (hashed), hit/miss, shard_id, and model_version. Spans are low-cardinality-friendly and do not include prompt text. - Dashboard: new Grafana dashboard with panels for hit/miss rates, hit ratio over time, per-model miss cost, token_processing_latency P50/P95/P99 (and P99.9), and a top-talkers table showing routes with highest miss cost. - Alerts: added/adjusted alerts to trigger on sustained high miss ratio (5m window) and on rising per-token miss cost per route. Alerts include min-traffic gating, mute/burn rules, severity (warning/critical), runbook links, and escalation policy references. - Tests and validation: unit tests for metrics counters and histogram buckets; integration validation in perf-canary; dashboard validation tool enforced. Commits (summary): feat(observability): token-level KV metrics + tests; feat(tracing): instrument kv lookup/populate spans; chore(dashboards): add kv token metrics dashboard; infra(alerts): add KV cache alerting rules; fix(tests): adjust histogram buckets after perf-canary feedback. Files changed (high-level): services/kv/metrics.go, services/kv/tracing.go, dashboards/kv-token-metrics-dashboard.json, monitors/alerts/kv_cache_alerts.tf, docs/observability/kv-cache-metrics.md, perf-canary/config/kv-miss-workload.yaml, tests/observability/kv_metrics_test.go, README.md, infra/terraform/modules/observability/inputs.tf, scripts/dashboard-validate.sh, charts/observability/values.yaml, examples/observability/kv-metrics-example.md. Testing/CI: The first integration run failed due to histogram bucket mismatch; adjusted buckets and re-ran. All CI checks pass. Perf canary detects synthetic miss spikes and shows a clean baseline. Review conversation (summary): Raj: ensure span attributes are low-cardinality; don't include raw cache keys. Author: switched to key_id (sha1 prefix 8 chars) and added doc note about no prompt data in spans. Elena: buckets might not cover heavy tails; recommend adding P99.9 and changing bucket growth. Author: adjusted buckets to exponential growth up to 2s/token and added perf-canary validations. Samir: alert thresholds noisy for small routes; add min-traffic gating. Author: added min_requests_per_minute gating and updated runbooks. Approvals: Elena approved, Samir approved after tuning, Raj approved after span update. Merge: Squash-and-merge by Raj Patel on 2025-02-20. Backward compatibility: Metric names are additive and tracing attributes are low-cardinality; alerts include grace periods and gating to avoid noisy paging.
